ValidationRule.description: This is to restrict users from saving $0 in payment amount fields where the complaint remedy is 'credit approved remedy' and the sub remedy is 'debt waiver' or 'settle for less'
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, NOT( ISNEW() ), OR( IDR_Complaint__r.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint' || IDR_Complaint__r.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint' ), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL( IDR_Complaint_Remedy__c , '4'), OR( ISPICKVAL( IDR_Complaint_Sub_Remedy__c , '10'), ISPICKVAL( IDR_Complaint_Sub_Remedy__c , '18')), IDR_Financial_Compensation__c = 0 ), AND( ISPICKVAL( IDR_Complaint_Remedy_Offered__c , '4'), OR( ISPICKVAL( IDR_Complaint_Sub_Remedy_Offered__c , '10'), ISPICKVAL( IDR_Complaint_Sub_Remedy_Offered__c , '18')), IDR_Payment_Amount_Offered__c = 0 ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Financial compensation or non-financial remedy must be populated based on the selection in complaint remedy and the other field must be left blank.
